question: What makes countries near the equator hotter than those which are away from the equator?

options.text: Areas near the equator receive direct and more sunlight.
Areas near the equator have more volcanoes.
The equator is a hot line.
The equator is near the earth's core.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Areas near the equator receive direct and more sunlight.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Areas near the equator receive direct and more sunlight.** This is because the sun's rays hit the equator more directly than they do at higher latitudes.
 
• The** concentration of solar energy is higher at the equator, leading to warmer temperatures year-round**.
